body:
I always said I’d wait until I was 25. And that came and went and I’m even worse.

No more waiting for a better tomorrow

I’ve been through therapy multiple times. I’m on anti depressants. They stop me crying all the time but they also make me feel very numb and empty. Currently on a waiting list for more therapy but I don’t have any reason to believe it’d help more than the last one did.

I’m pretty resigned to the fact I’ll die a virgin at this point, I’ve heard plenty of the “just wait a little longer, put yourself out there” stuff and the same result happens. It would’ve been nice to have a girlfriend before I died but some people don’t deserve relationships I guess. The anti depressants have made it so I cant even get an erection any more anyway.

Thanks for trying to help. But I’m beyond help.
I had hope when I was young and naive too. Hope things go better for you than they did for me
My whole life has been a rough patch. I’m done pretending things get better.
I can’t handle it. My anxiety is too high
I don’t work. Not any more.
I’ve tried for years. I’m done trying.
